insurer: Universal Sompo General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Base plan has no room rent limit. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' can restrict to Single Private AC Room or Twin Sharing Room if opted.

icu.note: No separate restriction on ICU charges under base plan. Also no ICU cap under Room Rent Modification optional benefit.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional co-payment benefit available for premium discount. Smart Select optional benefit imposes 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals.

sub_limits.note: Policy wording does not specify any disease-wise or procedure-wise sub-limits in the base plan. Payment terms mention sub-limits generically but none are listed for this product.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional Benefit 'Deductible' available for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Benefit 'PED Wait Period Modification' can reduce this; 'Instant Cover' add-on waives PED wait for Diabetes/Hypertension/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailment waiting period is 24 months for listed conditions (cataract, hernia, etc.). Optional Benefit 'Named Ailment Wait Period Modification' can reduce this.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Excl18) under the base plan. Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned in this wording.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% flat increase per claim-free year, max 100% of SI. No reduction on claim. Optional 'Cumulative Bonus Super' adds further 100%/yr up to 500% of SI.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates full base SI unlimited times per year after exhaustion. Usable for same or different illnesses.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to SI.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI for treatment exceeding 3 consecutive days at home. Certain conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.) excluded under domiciliary.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to SI at registered AYUSH hospitals, subject to hospitalisation claim being admissible.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's harvesting surgery expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to SI as part of hospitalisation claim. Air ambulance available as optional add-on with limit as per policy schedule.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed advance technology methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to SI.

consumables.note: Optional Benefit 'Claim Shield' covers List-I non-medical/consumable items otherwise excluded, up to applicable SI.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except for established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly modes; 15 days for monthly mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies only.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity (except ectopic), hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, refractive error <7.5D, non-listed advance tech methods

optional_riders.display: Room Rent Modification, PED/Named Ailment Wait Reduction, Instant Cover, Deductible, Co-payment, Cumulative Bonus Super, Air Ambulance, Claim Shield, Inflation Shield, Critical Illness Add-on SI, Plus Benefit, Women Care, Mental Health, Wellness, Be-Fit, Annual Health Check-up
